acceptance_criteria: Identity(n)[i, j] should represent symbolic equality without assuming off-diagonal zero.
Nested sums over Identity(n) entries should evaluate to n for a positive symbolic size.
Any helper added for KroneckerDelta or Piecewise summation should not change unrelated finite Piecewise sums.
issue: Identity matrix entries with symbolic indices should preserve the undecidable i == j case so nested sums of identity entries simplify correctly.
